note: Verdicts for upstream commits touching packages this fork deleted. Regenerate with `bun scripts/check-upstream-v2-delta.mjs --update`; see scripts/check-upstream-v2-delta.mjs for the gate itself. `tracked` = accepted debt recorded in packages/kimi-agent/ROADMAP.md §6; `not-applicable` = internal refactor with no observable engine behavior to port.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): invalidate streamed attempt state when the llm requester retries below the turn (#3734)
entries.note: Rust turn_loop/retry.rs has no attempt-state invalidation; streamed deltas from a discarded attempt may survive into the retry.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): add KIMI_CODE_PERMISSION_MODE_REMINDER env to disable auto-mode reminders (#3728)
entries.note: The whole permission_mode reminder injection is absent from the fork (engine and app); the env flag is only its switch.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): compose the llm recovery chain outside the turn machine (#3724)
entries.note: Internal service composition inside the TS turn machine; Rust drives retries in turn_step/run_turn directly.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): suppress task notifications before loop quiescence on remove (#3720)
entries.note: Task-notification timing nuance; Rust TaskRunner lifecycle not compared against this rule yet.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): rebuild session and search indexes on storage failures, journal session-index freshness (#3694)
entries.note: Rust session/sqlite_store.rs has no rebuild/reindex path on storage failure.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): keep late task settlement silent after agent teardown (#3717)
entries.note: Late-settlement silencing after teardown; Rust TaskRunner not compared against this rule yet.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): stop warning on unhandled store.changed events (#3715)
entries.note: Log-noise fix for the TS store event bus; Rust has no store.changed analogue.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): allow rm -rf targeting only /tmp or /temp paths (#3714)
entries.note: Ported to native/permission_engine/dangerous_command.rs (RM_SAFE_TEMP_ROOTS + is_safe_temp_rm_operand) with tests.

entries.subject: fix(goal): remove time budget cap and exclude offline time (#3657)
entries.note: MAX_REASONABLE_TIME_BUDGET_MS removed from goal/mod.rs; non-finite guard added; SetGoalBudget description and tests updated.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): plug llm credentials in through request config (#3682)
entries.note: Internal DI composition for credentials; Rust llm/http and config own credential resolution.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): drop the llm state machine, let turn invoke the request actor directly (#3710)
entries.note: Removal of a TS xstate machine; Rust has no equivalent state machine.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): replace ProtocolTrait with per-protocol typed traits composed in the requester pipeline (#3641)
entries.note: Internal trait shape; Rust llm/{openai,anthropic,google_genai,openai_responses}.rs are already per-protocol.

entries.subject: feat(kap-server): add flat entity message protocol (v3 WS + history API) (#3532)
entries.note: Contract-generation gap: Rust server exposes no v3 flat-entity WS/history surface, and apps/kimi-inspect still matches the pre-#3532 protocol.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): let steer interrupt background task waits (#3697)
entries.note: Rust steer handling is goal-steering text only; no evidence a steer interrupts a background-task wait.

entries.subject: feat(tower): reliability fixes (#3648)
entries.note: Upstream rewrote tower protocol store/send/spawn; per-fix comparison against Rust tools/tower/ not done.

entries.subject: fix(mcp): preserve original attachments omitted from model output (#3688)
entries.note: Rust preserves structuredContent/_meta but has no session-attachment original preservation.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): event-source the human agent state store (#3691)
entries.note: Applies to the TS human agent machine (human/agent/), which has no Rust counterpart; needs a decision, not necessarily a port.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): warn on [models] entries missing the model field (#3681)
entries.note: Config validation warning; Rust config/mod.rs not compared yet.

entries.subject: feat(kap-server): stream raw xstate inspection events over /api/v1/debug/ws (#3687)
entries.note: Debug WS inspection stream; Rust server/debug.rs exposes REST only.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): remove AgentActivityView and project v1 agent phase at kap-server edge (#3678)
entries.note: Removal of a TS view model plus edge projection; Rust server projects its own phases.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): rewire the model catalog runtime onto the provider-catalog state machine (#3606)
entries.note: Model-catalog runtime behavior; Rust catalog surface not compared against the state-machine semantics.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): single producer for turn and step ids (#3662)
entries.note: Rust receives turn_id from the caller and owns step ids internally; no duplicate-producer risk.
